title: And God Saw That It Was Good

request.style: English, cinematic orchestral hymn, soprano lead with mixed choir, full string section, French horns, harp, timpani, celesta, majestic and full of wonder, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth
The earth was formless and empty
Darkness lay over the face of the deep
And the Spirit of God hovered over the face of the waters

[Chorus]
And God said, Let there be light, and there was light
And God saw that it was good
And there was evening, and there was morning
And God saw that it was good

[Verse]
He spread the vault among the waters and he named the heavens high
He gathered seas into one place, and the dry land met the sky
The land brought forth its green growth, every seed and fruit and tree
He set the lights to rule the day and night, and stars for all to see

[Chorus]
And God said, Let there be light, and there was light
And God saw that it was good
And there was evening, and there was morning
And God saw that it was good

[Verse]
The waters teemed with living creatures and the birds took to the air
The great sea creatures filled the deep, and life was everywhere
The livestock and the wild things and the creeping things that roam
Each according to its kind, and the earth became their home

[Bridge]
So God created man in his own image
In the image of God he created him
Male and female he created them
God saw all that he had made, and behold, it was very good

[Outro]
On the seventh day he rested from all the work he had done
Then God blessed the seventh day and made it holy
And God saw that it was good
